Adalberto Carrasquilla.note: Carrasquilla is midfield insurance for Panama. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Adalberto Carrasquilla.noteZh: 他给Panama一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Alberto Quintero.note: Quintero gives Panama a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Alberto Quintero.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Andres Andrade.note: Andrade is in the quiet-work part of Panama's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Andres Andrade.noteZh: 他是Panama主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Anibal Godoy.note: Godoy gives Panama a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Anibal Godoy.noteZh: 他是Panama的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Azarias Londono.note: Londoño is an attacking change-up for Panama. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Azarias Londono.noteZh: 他是Panama的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Carlos Harvey.note: Harvey gives Panama structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Carlos Harvey.noteZh: 他给Panama控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Cecilio Waterman.note: Waterman is attacking depth for Panama. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Cecilio Waterman.noteZh: 他是Panama前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Cesar Blackman.note: Blackman gives Panama defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Cesar Blackman.noteZh: 他是Panama艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Cesar Samudio.note: Samudio is Panama's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Cesar Samudio.noteZh: 他是Panama的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Cesar Yanis.note: Yanis gives Panama a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Cesar Yanis.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Cristian Martinez.note: Martínez gives Panama structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Cristian Martinez.noteZh: 他给Panama控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Edgar Yoel Barcenas.note: Bárcenas has been part of Panama's front-line plan. He stretches defenders first, then looks for the touch that turns pressure into a chance.
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.noteZh: 他是Panama前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Edgardo Farina.note: Fariña is the kind of defender Panama can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Edgardo Farina.noteZh: 他是Panama艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Eric Davis.note: Davis is defensive cover for Panama's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Eric Davis.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Fidel Escobar.note: Escobar is back-line insurance for Panama. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Fidel Escobar.noteZh: 他给Panama那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Ismael Diaz.note: Díaz is one of Panama's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Ismael Diaz.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Panama来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Jiovany Ramos.note: Ramos gives Panama defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Jiovany Ramos.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Jorge Gutierrez.note: Gutiérrez gives Panama cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Jorge Gutierrez.noteZh: 他是Panama后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jose Cordoba.note: Córdoba has been part of Panama's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Jose Cordoba.noteZh: 他在Panama体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Jose Fajardo.note: Fajardo is an attacking change-up for Panama. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Jose Fajardo.noteZh: 他是Panama的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Jose Luis Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez gives Panama a front-line rhythm that keeps defenders facing their own goal. His value often starts before the ball reaches him.
Jose Luis Rodriguez.noteZh: 他给Panama替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Luis Mejia.note: Mejía sits behind the starter for Panama, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Luis Mejia.noteZh: 他给Panama保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Michael Murillo.note: Murillo is the kind of defender Panama can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Michael Murillo.noteZh: 他是Panama艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Orlando Mosquera.note: Mosquera has carried the keeper minutes for Panama. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Orlando Mosquera.noteZh: 他是Panama防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Roderick Miller.note: Miller is defensive cover for Panama's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Roderick Miller.noteZh: 他是Panama在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Tomas Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez is the forward Panama can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Tomas Rodriguez.noteZh: 他给Panama替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。
